forbidden_narrowing: No claim that the Provider raw content-block shape is now known.
No claim that the historical root cause is closed.
No real Provider, network, model, paid, Full Short, retry, resume, or second-run action.
model_output_not_applicable_evidence: Production and BAML diff counts are zero; the only observer implementation is tools/canary/provider_capability_probe_contract.py and the unchanged source hashes/live parity are bound in r1-ptr4-v1-behavior-unchanged-proof-v1.json.

Boundary 3 semantic_validation_failed: preserved as the first unrecovered divergence.

Provider content-block shape: remains UNKNOWN until a separately authorized real probe.
projected_failure_mechanisms: A future Provider returns a tool-only, reasoning-only, mixed, empty, or unknown block topology.
The adapter loses visible text or tool-argument presence between pre-normalization and post-adapter observation.
A max_tokens response truncates text or tool arguments while retaining a typed content-block shape.
A fixture cannot be reconstructed exactly from the sealed sanitized source and request hashes.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Store metadata only and keep all external actions at zero.

The exact Boundary 12 identity is hash-bound and the offline matrix covers text/tool/reasoning/empty/mixed/unknown and adapter-loss shapes.

rollback: Delete only the files added under tools/canary, tests/canary, and docs/superpowers/reports/r1-ptr4-v1 by this task.
